metadata.title: PoSHive
metadata.description: Control your British Gas Hive system (heating, multi-zone heating, hot water, active plugs, sensors, bulbs, partner (Philips Hue) bulbs) and get temperature history as data or charts using PowerShell.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Hive' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00001.ps1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
